name: cis4150-ai-test-study
description: CIS*4150 term project: do AI-generated tests protect software reliability? A case study on ShadowBoxer.

scripts.mutation:codex: SUITE=codex stryker run && node scripts/summarize-mutation.mjs codex
scripts.mutation:stripped: SUITE=stripped stryker run && node scripts/summarize-mutation.mjs stripped
scripts.bugs: node scripts/check-bugs.mjs && node scripts/run-bugs.mjs codex stripped
scripts.results: node scripts/make-stripped.mjs && npm run -s test:codex > results/test-codex.txt && npm run -s test:stripped > results/test-stripped.txt && npm run -s coverage:codex > results/coverage-codex.txt && npm run -s coverage:stripped > results/coverage-stripped.txt && npm run -s bugs && npm run -s weak-checks > /dev/null && npm run -s flakiness && npm run -s summary
scripts.mutation: npm run mutation:codex && npm run mutation:stripped
